limits: Disposable Chromium mobile viewport and native modular world over local RTDB/SSE. No production account, database or permissions test.
Clock advances in native 60 Hz simulation steps. Drawing is capped; simulation duration and wall duration are reported separately. No physical-device FPS, temperature or battery claim.

Player/vehicle positions and damaged workshop fixtures are prepared before each scenario. Actual routes, collision predicates, responders, repair/collection, storage, purchase, receipt and save/reload run unchanged.

Incidents are created through the native incident constructor; native responders and central backup decide completion. The test records forced-clear/arrival details instead of claiming every responder physically arrived.
Heap samples use the same CDP collectGarbage command after warm-up and after each settled cycle. They are laboratory retained-heap observations, not mobile memory limits.
